name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Curated plugins for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. Two kinds are listed side by side: Claude-format plugins, which the harness reads as skills, and dsh-format plugins, which it loads as code.

metadata.note: The app reads this file directly out of the repository. There is no site build and no release step between an edit here and a user seeing it.

plugins.name: desktop-plugin-authoring
plugins.description: How to write, list and get a plugin into this marketplace: the two formats, what each can reach, and the rules CI enforces.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-background-color
plugins.description: Repaint the window frame, sidebar and conversation view with one colour per light and dark scheme.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
plugins.description: Frosted, translucent panels in the spirit of Apple's Liquid Glass: backdrop blur, a specular top edge and generous corners on the dialogs, the composer and the sidebar.
